title: But What Will People Say?
description: This wonderful book is a compass, a blueprint, a mirror, and a friend. Kohli gives language to what many of us feel but can’t yet articulate. - Erika L. Sánchez, New York Times bestselling author of I am Not Your Perfect Mexican DaughterLoving, culturally informed, and holistic… [Kohli] compassionately shares her own story, and guides readers through the nuances and pain of assimilation, individuation, and mental ...
